boards.title: Your First Weekend at Point Loma Nazarene University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A gentle, under-21-safe first-weekend route through campus landmarks, student resources, and ways to begin participating in PLNU life.

cards.title: Start with a campus tour
cards.subtitle: First stop: get oriented
cards.notes: Join the campus-tour portion of new-student programming, then save the map and identify the buildings you expect to use during your first week.
cards.short_summary: Use the official orientation tour to put names and routes to the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s new-student orientation describes campus tours as part of the program.
cards.access_notes: Orientation programming is for new students; check the current schedule and registration details.

cards.title: Pause at Brown Chapel
cards.subtitle: A landmark on the new-student route
cards.notes: Locate Brown Chapel early and review the current Welcome Week or chapel schedule before attending a university gathering there.
cards.short_summary: Brown Chapel hosts documented new-student and university programming.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s orientation schedule lists the Covenant and Sand Tradition at Brown Chapel, and Welcome Week lists a Covenant Service.
cards.access_notes: Use the published Welcome Week schedule; event details can change.

cards.title: Learn the Sand Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week tradition
cards.notes: If your arrival schedule includes it, take part with your incoming class and keep the moment simple: it marks entry into the PLNU community.
cards.short_summary: A documented PLNU Welcome Week tradition centered on communal sand.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU says each student pours beach-collected sand into a communal tank during the Sand Ceremony, symbolizing entry into the community.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience | PLNU
cards.access_notes: This is scheduled as part of Welcome Week; confirm your current orientation itinerary.

cards.title: Make Nicholson Commons your hub
cards.subtitle: Campus services and dining
cards.notes: Walk through Nicholson Commons to find the bookstore, dining options, and the Activities and Recreation Center before you need them.
cards.short_summary: One map-listed hub for several everyday student destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s campus map lists Nicholson Commons with the bookstore, Bobby B’s Coffee Company, Dining Hall, Point Break Restaurant, and ARC-related services.
cards.access_notes: Campus buildings and services may have separate hours and access rules.

cards.title: Have a low-key meal at Point Break
cards.subtitle: Nicholson Commons dining stop
cards.notes: Use the official campus map to find Point Break in Nicholson Commons, then check current dining information before choosing a meal time.
cards.short_summary: A named campus restaurant mapped inside Nicholson Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s campus map lists Point Break Restaurant in Nicholson Commons.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases and current dining availability should be confirmed with campus dining.

cards.title: Find Ryan Library before classes begin
cards.subtitle: A mapped academic destination
cards.notes: Walk to Ryan Library, note its entrances and nearby routes, and plan a return visit when you need a focused academic setting.
cards.short_summary: Get oriented to a central named library before coursework accelerates.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s campus map identifies Ryan Library as a campus academic and administrative facility.
cards.access_notes: Check library access and service hours before visiting.

cards.title: Ask the ARC about outdoor recreation
cards.subtitle: Nicholson Commons, first floor
cards.notes: Stop by the ARC to learn about outdoor programs or equipment rentals; choose an activity that matches your experience and the current calendar.
cards.short_summary: The ARC is the on-campus base for PLNU outdoor recreation information and rentals.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU locates Outdoor Leadership and Recreation in the ARC on the first floor of Nicholson Commons and says students can rent outdoor equipment there.
cards.source_title: Student Leadership and Outdoor Recreation | PLNU
cards.access_notes: The office publishes hours; rentals, trips, and eligibility may involve separate requirements or fees.

cards.title: Check out Golden Gym
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Sea Lion events
cards.notes: Locate Golden Gym and check open-gym availability before working out or attending a game; bring only the gear required by current facility rules.
cards.short_summary: A mapped athletic venue with student open-gym access described by PLNU.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s new-student guide says Golden Gym is available during open gym hours for the weight room, aerobics area, tennis, basketball, and volleyball courts.
cards.access_notes: Open-gym availability varies; verify current facility hours before going.

cards.title: Join the Green Sea at a game
cards.subtitle: PLNU student cheering section
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled home game or match, wear green and gold if you have it, and join the student section in supporting Sea Lion teams.
cards.short_summary: A documented student cheering tradition connected with PLNU athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU describes the Green Sea as its student cheering section and says students can join by wearing green and gold and finding the student section.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience | PLNU
cards.access_notes: Attend a currently scheduled event and follow venue entry policies.

cards.title: End with the Greek Amphitheatre
cards.subtitle: Campus performance landmark
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk to the Greek Amphitheatre, orient yourself using the campus map, and check the official calendar for any public campus programming.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor campus landmark used in PLNU tradition coverage.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s campus map identifies the Greek Amphitheatre, and PLNU’s traditions page identifies it as the site of Loma Live during Homecoming.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience | PLNU
cards.access_notes: Treat it as an outdoor landmark; confirm event access and timing through the official calendar.
